# Step - store

`store` · category: [Aggregation](../../traversal/step_reference.md#aggregation)

Like aggregate(), but adds each value lazily, without a barrier.

## Forms

```text
store(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_label("software").values("name").store("s").cap("s").next()   // ["lop", "ripple"]
```
